name: BGM-109 Tomahawk (TLAM)
description: Ship-launched land-attack cruise missile — the fleet's deep-strike arm. Turbofan-subsonic, GPS/INS + TERCOM, sea-skims off the launch then terrain-follows ~50 m AGL inland before popping up and diving on the GPS coord. Real range ~1600 km; capped at strike-package scale here. Fire-and-forget, no terminal seeker — defeated only by GPS jamming or a leaker getting shot down. Visual stand-in: AGM-86 ALCM body.
